articles.title: Emerson Electric (NYSE:EMR) Posts Q4 CY2025 Sales In Line With Estimates
articles.mainIdea: Emerson Electric (NYSE:EMR) Posts Q4 CY2025 Sales In Line With Estimates
articles.summary: StockStory: Emerson Electric (NYSE:EMR) Posts Q4 CY2025 Sales In Line With Estimates. Engineering and automation solutions company Emerson (NYSE:EMR) met Wall Streets revenue expectations in Q4 CY2025, with sales up 4.1% year on year to $4.35 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.46 per share was 3.4% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

articles.summary: Associated Press Finance: Emerson Electric: Fiscal Q1 Earnings Snapshot. ST. LOUIS (AP) — Emerson Electric Co. (EMR) on Tuesday reported fiscal first-quarter earnings of $605 million. The St. Louis-based company said it had net income of $1.07 per share.
